title: Text Education About Cardiovascular Health and HIV (TEACH-HIV)
official: Text Education About Cardiovascular Health and HIV (TEACH-HIV)
summary: The overall objective is to evaluate the efficacy of educational text messages to reduce cardiovascular risk among persons living with HIV (PLWH).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV positive
* At least 40 years of age
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Existing clinical atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD)
* Pregnant
* Unwilling/unable to provide informed consent
* Does not own a smartphone
